shared_elements: human/anthropomorphic figure with detailed hair or headdress
incised linear detailing of garments or hair
figures rendered in a formal, frontal or profile stance
justification: Both surfaces depict anthropomorphic figures carved in stone with incised linear treatment of hair/beard and garment, which is the only real correspondence. A is a single massive frontal figure dominated by a large concentric disc on the torso and heavy schematic body forms, while B shows a repeated procession of small, evenly spaced profile figures in a horizontal register along a stair facade — different compositional schemes, scale conventions and subject matter.
